title: Plague Bokwin
extract:
The Plague Bokwin is an Infested Grip for Zaws.

Acquisition
Plague Bokwin is obtainable from limited-time events:
Operation: Plague Star sold Plague Bokwin from Nakak for  2,000 +  3,500, requiring Rank 3 - Champion with Operational Supply.
The October 2020, 2022, and 2024 Nights of Naberus event sold Plague Bokwin from Daughter for 25  Mother Tokens each.
While the actual Grip itself cannot usually be acquired outside of events, it can still appear as part of a complete Zaw in Hok's Daily Specials.

Notes
The Plague Bokwin creates the following weapons:

Hammer
Heavy Blade
Staves
Polearms

Patch History
